tiers.label: Starter
tiers.description: Quick interview: capture the minimum architecture needed to start safely, with only the core product, stack, and constraints.

tiers.label: Standard
tiers.description: Balanced interview: collect product shape, implementation choices, and the key technical decisions that affect the first release.

tiers.label: Deep
tiers.description: Deep interview: include testing, deployment, security, compliance, and operational details for a production-ready plan.

projectTypes.label: Web Application
projectTypes.description: Browser-based app with routing, UI framework, and API layer

projectTypes.label: Library / Package
projectTypes.description: Reusable npm package with public API, dual ESM/CJS

projectTypes.label: Backend / API
projectTypes.description: Express, Fastify, or Hono REST/GraphQL API server

projectTypes.label: Mobile App (Expo)
projectTypes.description: React Native mobile app with Expo, EAS Build, and Expo Router

stacks.label: Vanilla JS
stacks.description: Plain JavaScript with rule-frontend-vanilla-reactive: Proxy Store, Signals, Custom Elements

stacks.label: React 18+
stacks.description: Functional components, hooks, JSX, Context API — SSR with Next.js or Remix

stacks.label: Vue 3
stacks.description: Composition API, SFC, ref/reactive/computed, scoped CSS — SSR with Nuxt.js

stacks.label: SolidJS
stacks.description: Fine-grained reactivity, createSignal/createMemo, JSX — fastest runtime

stacks.label: Svelte 5
stacks.description: Runes ($state, $derived, $effect), minimal boilerplate — SSR with SvelteKit

stacks.label: Astro
stacks.description: Islands architecture, multi-framework components, content-first static sites

stacks.label: Next.js
stacks.description: React meta-framework: App Router, SSR/SSG/ISR, API routes, middleware

stacks.label: Nuxt.js
stacks.description: Vue meta-framework: file-based routing, SSR/SSG, server routes, Nitro engine

stacks.label: Remix
stacks.description: React meta-framework: nested routing, loaders/actions, progressive enhancement

stacks.label: Electron
stacks.description: Cross-platform desktop: Chromium + Node.js, contextBridge IPC, auto-update

stacks.label: Tauri
stacks.description: Lightweight desktop: system webview + Rust backend, small bundle size

stacks.label: Express
stacks.description: Minimal Node.js web framework, large ecosystem, easy to get started

stacks.label: Fastify
stacks.description: Fast Node.js web framework, schema-based validation, plugin system

stacks.label: Hono
stacks.description: Ultralight Node.js/Edge framework, fastest routing, multi-runtime

designSystems.label: Vanilla CSS
designSystems.description: Plain CSS with custom properties, cascade layers, and low-level primitives for maximum control.

designSystems.label: Tailwind CSS
designSystems.description: Utility-first styling for rapid UI assembly with reusable design tokens and atomic classes.

designSystems.label: Bootstrap
designSystems.description: Opinionated component library with responsive defaults and quick, familiar scaffolding.

designSystems.label: Material Design (MUI)
designSystems.description: Material Design component system for polished application UIs and complex interaction states.

designSystems.label: DaisyUI
designSystems.description: Tailwind component layer with themed UI primitives and fast setup.

designSystems.label: Open Props
designSystems.description: Design token and CSS variable system for scalable theming and consistent spacing.

architectureSkills.label: rule-styleguide — HTML, CSS, JS, a11y, naming

apiStyles.label: REST (OpenAPI)
apiStyles.description: Resource-oriented HTTP API with explicit endpoints, predictable status codes, and OpenAPI-friendly contracts.

apiStyles.label: GraphQL
apiStyles.description: Typed graph endpoint for clients that need flexible field selection and fewer round-trips.

apiStyles.label: tRPC
apiStyles.description: End-to-end typed RPC for TypeScript stacks when you want client and server to share the same contract.

apiStyles.label: WebSocket / Realtime
apiStyles.description: Realtime bidirectional channel for live updates, collaboration, presence, and push events.

apiStyles.label: Local Only (no network)
apiStyles.description: No network layer: local filesystem, IPC, or embedded APIs for fully offline products.

databaseEngines.label: PostgreSQL
databaseEngines.description: Relational database for transactional backends, strong constraints, advanced SQL, and long-lived data models.

databaseEngines.label: MySQL
databaseEngines.description: Relational database with broad hosting support, mature tooling, and straightforward operational setup.

databaseEngines.label: SQLite
databaseEngines.description: Embedded relational database for local-first apps, offline storage, and zero-config persistence in a single file.

databaseEngines.label: MongoDB
databaseEngines.description: Document database for flexible schemas, fast iteration, and JSON-shaped application data.

databaseEngines.label: DuckDB
databaseEngines.description: Embedded analytical database for local processing, reporting, and fast in-process queries.

databaseEngines.label: IndexedDB / Filesystem
databaseEngines.description: Browser or filesystem storage for offline-capable apps that need local persistence without a server.
